reviews.x: Someone gave me a soap saver a year ago and I loved it even though there were a few artisan soaps that didn't quite fit in it because the soap was large.  Looking for something a little bigger, I researched and found this.  Loved the blue color and, because it was a little more expensive than the others, I purchased it thinking it would be nicer.  This is a BIG waste of money.  It arrived with strings hanging off of it.  It's thin and rough.  Thankfully, I didn't purchase it as a scrubber becaus
I own both the black and blue soap savers and they are both made from a semi soft cloth material that is perfect for scrubbing in the shower. Not too rough like the white and pink models.

I have a feeling this thing is homemade but that does NOT take away from its usefulness!  My soap stays high and dry every shower!  I had such a problem with my bar soap getting all mushy and wasted before I bought this bag. I live in a household of 10 and we all have to share the same shower so needless to say there is constantly water running in that shower. The days of ruined soap bars are over since i bought this though! I just loop it over the shower bar and it hangs there nice and dry unti
Works fine. A little too rough to use on the face.  Seemed flimsy at first, but has held up well.

Bought this for an elderly lady who kept dropping her soap in the shower and was at risk of falling.  This little bag was the answer to her problem and she loves it.  A good alternative to the soap-on-a-rope that we used to buy for her.

I've had a history of droping items picked up. The most trouble was in the shower when  I droped the bar of soap. Wet and slick it was hard to get a grip with my fingers. No problem now,,,,,the Soap Saver on Rope is the greatest thing. The rope ties anywhere and the soap will never drop again.

i got this product to help my kids stop dropping the soap in the bathtub. I like it. It is good quality. I was expecting it to be a little bit of a softer mesh (its kinda scratchy for kids) but they actually don't seem to mind and it gets the job done.
This was so cheap, I'm not sure I will even use it. I bought it for a gift, but couldn't send it because it just wasn't 'gift' quality.  A better fabric quality would have been nice.

reviews.t: Blue Soap Saver soap on a rope makes bar soap less messy & last longer
reviews.x: Blue Soap Saver soap on a rope makes bar soap less messy & last longer. I use it haging from the shoer neck, with a bath "scrubby", Example - http://www.amazon.com/Bulk-Buys-Nylon-Bath-Scrubbies%252c/dp/B00G8FA32Q/ref=sr_1_10?ie=UTF8&qid=1393198596&sr=8-10&keywords=washcloth+scrubby it works great, also use liquid soap just nice to use the unusual scents availible as bars soaps too! Also no soap scum!
Does the job.  I'm super economical (cheap?) and hate throwing away little pieces of soap.  Now I "bag 'em" and get every last bubble of soap I paid for!  I like that I can hang it in my shower, too.

reviews.t: Wouldn't recommend, try a different soap pouch.
reviews.x: Product is much smaller and cheap feeling than I expected. Doesn't lather soap very well either.
Works well but surface is very rough on the skin.
Just what I wanted. Thank you.  Quick service.

reviews.t: Using all my wonderful soap slivers!
reviews.x: A friend makes soap which is excellent so I refuse to throw away the slivers--but they were piling up and impossible to use, so I was looking for an item like this and I am perfectly happy with it.  I wrap the wash cloth around the bag,  get it quite wet and lather the cloth exactly as with a bar of soap (pulling the string out of the way).  Works great and saves all that soap.  I'll probably put bigger bars in it as the smaller ones disappear since I see no reason to wait for slivers....I find

reviews.t: Best soap-on-a-rope is the one you make with this Soap Saver
reviews.x: We use these Soap Savers all over the house:  no more liquid soap for us, and no more messy bars on the side of the sink.  And in the shower, we can easily tell his soap from mine.  I'm hoping more colors will become available.  I highly recommend this product.

i bought 2 for gifts. my mom didn't like it & gave hers to me. i haven't tried it yet...i will when what i'm currently using wears out. my sister said she loved it, but she might of said that just trying to be nice ~ not wanting to hurt my feelings.
I've had this for a few years and it's starting to come apart, and I'll get another one. Very nice for saving soap that would otherwise get thrown out. Also works for scrubbing.
It works! Provides a place to put perfectly good slivers of soap so they can be used until they "disappear"!!! I know; it's always been one of my obsessions!

reviews.t: The product is exactly what I was looking for. ...
reviews.x: The product is exactly what I was looking for.  The fabric could be a little softer but I usually scrub with my nails so it's not too abrasive for me.

reviews.t: Junk - bad knock off of original
reviews.x: Junk, cheap plastic mesh. Looks like something you would get on your oranges from the store. Very rough to the touch with large openings.
It has held up from a few days of usage. I did not think it would because it felt cheap because of the thin material but so far so good.
Much better than I imagined! A great method for utilizing all of the bar soap product. Provides a generous amount of lather every time.
I got this for hubby as he hates when the soap falls down drain when showering and he wants all his moneys worth lol he will love this
This works well - easy to pick soap up when it falls and b/c of net bag is less apt to slip out of hand.  Net bag acts like a loofah!

reviews.t: Worked great and never slipped into the ocean
reviews.x: Bought this soap saver for a sailing trip to the British Virgin Islands. Worked great and never slipped into the ocean.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the soap saver keeps bar soap from getting mushy, messy, or wasted, and helps it last longer.
Several reviewers praise the hanging rope design for preventing dropped soap, especially for elderly users or those with grip issues.
A common complaint is that the material is rough or scratchy on the skin, particularly for the face or for kids.
Some reviewers find the product cheap-feeling, flimsy, or too small, with one saying it doesn't lather well.
Reviewers frequently describe it as working well and doing the job as intended.
